overview: The Wi-SUN DCU (NLG6770-IN) provides secured interconnection of Wi-SUN field devices with WAN communication networks. Its capabilities include Wi-SUN FAN 1.0 support, remote device management, communication management, data storage and interface abstraction.

A choice of multiple WAN interfaces and mounting options makes it suitable for different deployment strategies and locations. It is ideal for small to medium mesh networks supporting up to 200 nodes on a single network (depending on the field scenario) for various IoT applications.

Built on an NXP i.MX6 Cortex-A7 running a Yocto based Linux system, it accepts a wide 85–528 VAC input with integrated over-voltage protection, offers 10 kV surge protection, tamper detection, 32 GB offline data storage and 4 hours of battery backup, and uses an external 5 dBi fibre-glass antenna for long range. LTE and Ethernet are standard; Wi-Fi is optional.
overview_note: * Node count depends on the field scenario. IP65 is self-certified per the brochure.
